# Azure OpenAI REST API Reference (image & audio, 2024-10-21 GA)

## API Versions
| API Surface | Latest Preview | Latest GA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Control Plane | 2025-07-01-preview | 2025-06-01 |
| Data Plane | v1 preview | v1 |

GA data plane inference spec documented: 2024-10-21.

## Supported Operations (image & audio page)
1. Transcriptions - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/audio/transcriptions
2. Translations - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/audio/translations
3. Image Generation - POST /openai/deployments/{deployment-id}/images/generations
(Chat, completions, embeddings documented in the v1 REST API reference.)

## Key Features
- New preview inference API (v1 preview) — see API lifecycle guide.
- Authentication: API Key (api-key header), Microsoft Entra ID (Bearer token).
